name: Odin's Gamble - Reborn
review:
Odin's Gamble - Reborn is a 4x6 Norse slot with 466 ways and wild multipliers. The bonus adds sticky wins and a roaming wild stack.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 19,333x cap and a 96.15% RTP.

The roaming wild stack in the bonus can move across the reels while sticky wins hold, and wild multipliers raise the stakes. Moody Norse art sets the tone.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
